import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import dedupe

emails = [" Ada@Example.com", "bob@example.com", "ada@example.com ", "", "  ", "Zed@example.com"]
print(dedupe.unique_emails(emails))
print(dedupe.unique_tags(dedupe.split_tags("Python; python ,Refactoring,, tools;TOOLS")))
print(dedupe.unique_emails([]), dedupe.unique_tags(iter(["b", "a", "B"])))
assert dedupe.unique_tags(["x", "X ", "y"]) == ["x", "y"]
print("ok")
